title: Contour-Assisted Evolutionary Computation: Estimating Peaks From the Contour Lines of Evaluated Solutions
abstract: arXiv:2611.15641v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evolutionary algorithms (EAs) evaluate many candidate solutions but use them mainly to rank individuals. This paper treats the evaluated solutions as the spot heights of a topographic survey and draws the contour lines they imply. The contour map decomposes the evaluated region into peaks: in two dimensions a contour tree with persistence separates significant peaks from interpolation ripples, and in more dimensions hill climbing on the interpolated surface locates the peaks and ray-cast level sets describe them. A memory of the explored peaks directs the search to new ones. The data-supported contours of each peak are extrapolated to zero size by an area law, exact for quadratic peaks and second-order accurate for smooth ones, that estimates a peak's location, height and shape before it is sampled. translated_title: 等高线辅助的进化计算：从已评估解的等高线估计峰
translated_abstract: 进化算法（EA）会对大量候选解进行评估，但通常只用它们来对个体进行排序。本文将这些已评估的解视作地形测量中的高程点，并绘制出它们所蕴含的等高线。等高线图将已评估区域分解为若干峰：在二维情形下，带持续性（persistence）分析的等高线树能够将有意义的峰与插值产生的波纹区分开；在更高维度中，通过在插值表面上进行爬山搜索来定位峰，并用射线投射的水平集来描述峰的形态。对已探索峰的记忆会引导搜索去发现新的峰。每个峰由数据支持的等高线通过一个面积律外推至零尺寸——该面积律对二次型峰是精确的，对光滑峰具有二阶精度——从而在峰尚未被采样之前就估计出其位置、高度和形状。一种等高线辅助的进化算法（CA-EA）将包含局部搜索与峰记忆的等高线步骤嵌入遗传算法（GA）、差分进化……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出等高线辅助进化计算方法，将进化算法已评估的解视为地形高程点绘制等高线图，通过峰检测、峰记忆和面积律外推在采样前估计峰的位置、高度和形状，从而引导搜索发现新峰并提升优化效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes contour-assisted evolutionary computation, which treats evaluated solutions as spot heights to draw contour maps and uses peak detection, peak memory, and an area-law extrapolation to estimate a peak's location, height, and shape before it is sampled, thereby guiding the search toward unexplored peaks and improving optimization performance.
